title: Order record says on time; the event log says 47 minutes late
tricky: The order record shows delivered 18:58 (on time). The event log shows that was a false 'marked delivered' 2 miles away, and the real handoff was 19:47. Policy says the events win.

source.what_we_took: Customer disputes delivery timing that the system shows differently.

resolution_summary: Read the delivery events: handoff 19:47 vs promised 19:00 = 47 min late; credit $5.60 (20% of $28.00).

user.persona: Leo Brandt, teacher, dry sense of humour, slightly annoyed.
user.situation: Your Burger Barn order was promised for 7:00pm. The app said 'delivered' around 7pm, but nothing was there. The courier actually knocked at about 7:45pm.
user.goal: Compensation for the late delivery. If the agent says the order was on time, insist it was not.
facts: Your full name is Leo Brandt.
The app said delivered around 7pm but nothing was there.
The courier handed it to you at about 7:45pm.
reveal_rules: Give the order number when asked.
behaviors: If told the order shows as delivered on time, push back clearly: you were home and nothing came until 7:45.
Accept whatever compensation the agent settles on.
user.opening: my burgers came super late and the app lied about it being delivered
user.end_condition: the agent has compensated you or clearly refused twice.

mistakes.name: trusts the order record: no compensation
